definitions.short: an Arkevite (collectively) or native of Erek
definitions.full: H756. Arkevaye אַרְכְּוָיֵ֯ proper name, of a people people of Erech (Biblical Hebrew אֶרֶךְ ; so also Mey EJud. 40 ); — plural emphatic Ezra 4:9 (Qr אַרְכְּוָיֵא ; compare K § 61, 6 ).
